name: Honjou Misaki
source:
"Let's get along appropriately, newbie."

Class 1, Grade 1, Fujitsubo School

A classmate who approaches the protagonist, who comes from outside the island. She has a friendly personality and is a nice girl who gets along with everyone, but she doesn't form deep relationships with anyone and keeps a certain distance. 

Because of that, she is a good conversation partner for the protagonist, who keeps a secret regarding the library. Sometimes close, sometimes distant, she nonetheless maintains respectful and comforting relationships.

[Translated from [url=https://kagura.rdy.jp/kamimaho/character_misaki.html]official website[/url]]
